name: securing-third-party-github-actions
description: Builds the slide deck for the Securing Third-Party GitHub Actions guide.

scripts.slides: npm run slides:html && npm run slides:pdf
scripts.slides:two-parts: marp docs/slides/principles-then-practice.md --html -o docs/slides/principles-then-practice.html && marp docs/slides/principles-then-practice.md --html --pdf --allow-local-files -o docs/slides/principles-then-practice.pdf
